mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6.5% indicates labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 6.5%, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in residential construction (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust economic activity and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through stronger corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and INDPRO fails when SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 indicates manufacturing contraction, which typically leads to reduced corporate profits and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days during late-cycle economic slowdowns.
failure_condition: When INDPRO falls below 100, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits (HOUST) above its 3-month moving average signals strong housing market activity, which is a leading indicator of consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST is rising above its 3-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5.5% signals a tight labor market that boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE falls below 5.5%, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and a rise in the core inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) indicates a central bank's response to inflationary pressures, which typically precedes a market rally as the economy avoids a recession.
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails when FEDFUNDS falls and CPIAUCSL rises but SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of manufacturing slowdown (INDPRO below 100) and rising unemployment (UNRATE above 6.0%), the S&P 500 tends to decline as corporate profits face headwinds, leading to negative returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO is below 100 and UNRATE is above 6.0%, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 45% of cases.
